remainingIssues: The '</ticket>' marker from the brief's AC16 list is not removed by redact(); it is removed by neutralise() (R12(e), prompt.js). The unit test asserts redact() leaves it intact; the end-to-end AC16 check on the outbound body belongs to the integration test after t13-app-wiring.

Accepted per spec D3/RISK-9 (unchanged): two adjacent cards in one digit run collapse to one placeholder (counts.card = 1); IPv4 addresses and date+time are over-redacted as phones; dotted/double-spaced cards and digits glued to letters are under-redacted.
DES-4 timings are wall-clock on this machine; the 200 ms budget has ~5x margin over the measured ~33-37 ms worst medians, but a heavily loaded CI host could approach it.
